title: Arden cardigan
cloth: 100% lambswool, spun and knitted in the Scottish Borders
summary: A chunky cable cardigan with horn buttons that gets softer every winter.
imageAlt: An oat cable-knit lambswool cardigan with horn buttons on a wooden hanger.
description: The Arden cardigan by Lowrie Knit: chunky oat lambswool cables, horn buttons, knitted in Scotland. In stock at Hem, 41 Linden Street, Millbrook.
content:
Lowrie is a family knitting mill that has made cardigans like this one since the fifties. The Arden is their heaviest: a deep cable up the front, a ribbed crew neck, and real horn buttons sewn on by hand.

Fit

Roomy through the body so it goes over a shirt. Most people take their usual size; size down for a closer fit.

Care

  • Hand wash cool, or dry clean
  • Dry flat, away from the radiator
  • Bring it back for a free de-pill every autumn

title: Field overshirt
cloth: Brushed cotton twill, woven in Lancashire
summary: A heavy twill shirt-jacket with two chest pockets. Wear it open over a knit.
imageAlt: A moss green brushed cotton overshirt with two chest pockets on a wooden hanger.
description: The Field overshirt by Harwell & Sons in moss brushed cotton twill. A heavy shirt-jacket with two chest pockets, in stock at Hem in Millbrook.
content:
Harwell & Sons cut this from a twill heavy enough to wear as a jacket from September to the first frost, then brush it so it feels broken-in on the first day.

Fit

Boxy and a touch short, cut to sit over a sweater. Take your usual size.

Care

  • Machine wash at 30°, inside out
  • Line dry and it barely needs an iron

title: Tilda slip dress
summary: A bias-cut midi slip in washed silk that works with a tee, a knit or on its own.
imageAlt: An ink navy washed silk slip dress with thin straps on a wooden hanger.
description: The Tilda slip dress by Maud Studio in ink sand-washed silk. A bias-cut midi, made in Portugal and in stock at Hem, Millbrook.
content:
Maud Studio is two sisters in Porto who cut everything on the bias. The Tilda falls to mid-calf and moves like water; washing the silk takes the shine down so it wears in the daytime.

Fit

Skims rather than clings. The straps adjust, and Ruth can take the hem up for free.

Care

  • Hand wash cold with a little wool wash
  • Hang to dry, steam out any creases

title: Canvas wide-leg trouser
summary: High-waisted work trousers in stiff canvas that softens into your shape.
imageAlt: Rust orange wide-leg canvas trousers hanging from a wooden trouser hanger.
description: Pell Workwear canvas wide-leg trousers in rust organic cotton. High-waisted, made in the United States and in stock at Hem, Millbrook.
content:
Pell make workwear for people who actually work in it, and these trousers are built like a chore coat: triple-stitched seams, a riveted pocket, and canvas that starts stiff and ends up yours.

Fit

High on the waist and wide all the way down. Size by your waist; we hem them at the counter while you wait.

Care

  • Wash cold, inside out, as little as you can
  • They fade beautifully — that is the point

title: Marlow coat
summary: A long, unlined coat in boiled wool — warm, light and never stiff.
imageAlt: A long heather mauve boiled wool coat on a wooden hanger.
description: The Marlow coat by Oste in heather boiled wool: long, unlined and light. Felted in Austria and in stock at Hem, Millbrook.
content:
Boiled wool is knitted, then shrunk in hot water until it felts into a dense cloth that holds its shape without a lining. Oste cut the Marlow long and simple, so the cloth does all the work.

Fit

Relaxed, with room for a thick knit underneath. Take your usual size.

Care

  • Brush after wearing, air it outside
  • Dry clean only when it truly needs it

title: Merino rib beanie
summary: A fine rib hat with a deep cuff, soft enough to wear all day.
imageAlt: A lilac ribbed merino beanie with a folded cuff.
description: The Lowrie Knit merino rib beanie in lilac extra-fine merino. Knitted in Scotland, in stock at Hem, Millbrook.
content:
Knitted on the same frames as Lowrie's cardigans, from merino fine enough that it never itches. The cuff folds once or twice.

Care

  • Hand wash cool, dry flat

title: Market tote
cloth: Waxed cotton canvas and vegetable-tanned leather
summary: Our own tote, stitched two streets away. Holds a week of groceries.
imageAlt: A natural waxed canvas tote bag with brown leather handles.
description: The Hem market tote in waxed cotton canvas with leather handles, made two streets from the shop in Millbrook.
content:
The only thing in the shop with our name on it. Made by Aldo at Linden Leather, two streets away, in waxed canvas that shrugs off rain and handles that darken with use.

Details

  • 40 × 38 × 14 cm, one inside pocket
  • Re-waxed for free, for life

title: Breton long-sleeve
summary: The classic striped top, in a jersey heavy enough to last a decade.
imageAlt: An ecru and navy striped long-sleeve breton top on a wooden hanger.
description: The Saltmarsh breton long-sleeve in ecru and navy heavy cotton jersey, made in France. In stock at Hem, Millbrook.
content:
Saltmarsh still knit their jersey on old tubular machines, which is why it is thick, a little slubby, and why the stripes never twist after washing.

Fit

Straight and slightly cropped at the wrist. Take your usual size.

Care

  • Machine wash at 30°
  • Dry flat to keep the length
